name: CloudGate
description: CloudGate puts the services in your homelab on the internet, even when your connection has no public IP address or open ports (CGNAT, DS-Lite, mobile internet). It manages Cloudflare Tunnels and playit.gg tunnels from one web interface. Add a service by entering its local address and the public hostname you want. CloudGate creates the tunnel, the DNS record and the routing rule, and keeps the tunnel running. Features: - Cloudflare Tunnel for websites and web apps, with automatic DNS records - playit.gg tunnels for TCP/UDP services such as game servers and SSH - Optional local reverse proxy with Let's Encrypt certificates - Two-factor authentication, audit log and API keys - No configuration needed: the admin account and all secrets are created on first start Not affiliated with Cloudflare or playit.gg.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent CloudGate data: generated secrets, the SQLite database, and Cloudflare/nginx state.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Port for the CloudGate admin web UI.

variables.name: CLOUDGATE_DISABLE_UPDATES
variables.description: Disables CloudGate's built-in self-updater. Unraid updates the image instead - leave this set to true.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID to run the unprivileged parts of CloudGate as. The backend itself stays root (it reloads nginx/cloudflared).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID to run the unprivileged parts of CloudGate as.
